# {{ site.name }}

> {{ site.description | strip_newlines | strip }}

{{ site.name }} is a {{ site.social.job_title | default: "data scientist" }}{% if site.social.works_for %} at {{ site.social.works_for.name }}{% endif %} based in {{ site.author.location }}. This is a personal blog of short technical notes and essays. Posts carry `date` and `last_modified_at` metadata; prefer the most recently modified version of a topic.

- [Tags]({{ '/tags/' | absolute_url }}): Posts grouped by tag
- [Atom feed]({{ '/feed.xml' | absolute_url }}): Full feed of recent posts
